acceptable_paraphrases: A 5-sided shape with all angles and sides the same
critical_errors: No reference to regular or equality of sides/angles
Use of irregular in place of non-regular or not specifically stated
Reference to a hexagon, square, etc.
misconceptions: Assuming any pentagon is regular without evidence
Failing to distinguish between polygons and shapes in general
grading_notes: Note that synonyms like "A" or "the" do not affect correctness, but excessive use of these can make the answer hard to read.
